about_the_game:
Welcome to Dino Party, a wild multiplayer brawler where friendships are tested, and buildings don’t last long. Battle through a series of unpredictable minigames, punch your friends into oblivion, and tear down the arena in fully physics-driven destruction. Play online or locally—just be ready for absolute mayhem.

Seamless Minigame Mayhem

Experience non-stop action as the stadium morphs seamlessly between explosive minigames. Whether you’re teaming up for 2v2 soccer brawls, dodging crumbling lava floors, or surviving a frantic game of hot potato, every match throws unpredictable hazards. No two rounds are ever alike!

Punch First, Ask Questions Later

Two buttons. Endless chaos. String together punch combos to yeet rivals off cliffs, shield at the perfect moment to avoid disaster, or unleash the dreaded Assbomb™ (a butt-stomp so powerful, it’s legally required to yell “BOOM” when you land). Whether you’re a strategic shield-master or a button-mashing maniac, everyone gets to wreak havoc!

Unleash Your Inner Dino

Sometimes, you just want to let loose and wreck everything in sight. Smash through walls and watch entire floors collapse with physics-driven destruction that feels as satisfying as it sounds. Embrace your inner beast and turn the arena into your personal demolition zone.

Compete in Style

Who says dinosaurs can’t be stylish? Mix colors, patterns, and body-part cosmetics (robot tail? lava horns?) to create a creature that’s uniquely yours—then humble your friends with both your skills and your flawless dino-drip.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
